purpose: Continue sparse-state multiplicity with methodological-review, physical-entropy, biological-material, vulnerability-scanner, public-demographic and numismatic namespaces while keeping every identifier occurrence separate from physical evidence.

policy.rule: Raw exact-number occurrences are retained across all useful and control domains with zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: Article IDs, plasmid IDs, scanner plugin IDs, ZIP/geographic IDs and catalog numbers remain M1/N0 raw observations unless the digits themselves are independently verified physical quantities.
policy.no_hit: Post-coverage multiplicity remains append-only and does not erase earlier sparse/no-hit observations.
